proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4560 cakṣus gives Bengali cok(h)/cauk eye and Prakrit cakkhu. Bengali tʃok is the corresponding affricate transcription. Turner marks the eastern forms probably borrowed from Prakrit, so this family link retains that historical qualification. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: tʃok.
